```{r}
pops <- c("uk", "shetland", "norway", "spain")
chrs <- c(paste("chr", 1:14, sep = ""), "chrZ")

nsl_all <- expand.grid(pop = pops, chr = chrs, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    file = file.path(
      reports_path,
      "selection",
      pop,
      "nsl",
      chr,
      paste0(pop, "_", chr, "_nsl.nsl.out")
    ),
    data = map(file, \(f) {
      if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
      fread(f, header = TRUE) %>%
        dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("pop", "chr")))
    })
  ) %>%
  select(pop, chr, data) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(data)

chr_levels <- c(paste0("chr", 1:14), "chrZ")

make_pop_plot <- function(dat, pop_name) {

  df <- dat %>%
    filter(nsl > 0.5, pop == pop_name) %>%
    mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = chr_levels)) %>%
    arrange(chr, pos) %>%
    group_by(chr) %>%
    mutate(n_in_chr = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()

  axisdf <- df %>%
    count(chr, name = "n_snps") %>%
    mutate(
      end = cumsum(n_snps),
      start = lag(end, default = 0) + 1,
      center = (start + end) / 2
    )

  df <- df %>%
    left_join(axisdf %>% select(chr, start), by = "chr") %>%
    mutate(x = start + n_in_chr - 1)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = nsl, color = chr)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = axisdf$center,
      labels = gsub("^chr", "", axisdf$chr),
      expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = rep(c("#2C3E50", "#95A5A6"), length.out = length(chr_levels))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      text = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", size = 16),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "\nChromosome",
      y = "nSL\n",
      title = pop_name
    )
}

p_norway   <- make_pop_plot(nsl_all, "norway")
p_shetland <- make_pop_plot(nsl_all, "shetland")
p_spain    <- make_pop_plot(nsl_all, "spain")
p_uk       <- make_pop_plot(nsl_all, "uk")

final_plot <- (p_norway / p_shetland / p_spain / p_uk) 

final_plot

ggsave(
 final_plot,
  filename=file.path(figures_path, "selection", "nsl_all.png"),
  width = 18,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
chr_levels <- c(paste0("chr", 1:14), "chrZ")

make_pop_plot <- function(pop_name) {

  files <- setNames(
    file.path(
      reports_path,
      "selection",
      pop_name,
      "ihs",
      chrs,
      paste0(pop_name, "_", chrs, "_ihs.ihs.out")
    ),
    chrs
  )

  # Pass 1: count significant SNPs per chromosome
  counts <- map_dfr(names(files), function(chr_name) {
    f <- files[[chr_name]]
    if (!file.exists(f)) {
      return(tibble(chr = chr_name, n_snps = 0L))
    }

    dt <- fread(f, header = TRUE, select = "ihs")
    n_sig <- sum(dt$ihs > 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)
    rm(dt)
    gc()

    tibble(chr = chr_name, n_snps = n_sig)
  }) %>%
    mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = chr_levels)) %>%
    arrange(chr) %>%
    mutate(
      end = cumsum(n_snps),
      start = lag(end, default = 0L) + 1L,
      center = (start + end) / 2
    )

  # Pass 2: read each chromosome separately and keep only the filtered rows
  df_list <- vector("list", length(files))
  names(df_list) <- names(files)

  for (chr_name in names(files)) {
    f <- files[[chr_name]]
    if (!file.exists(f)) next

    start_chr <- counts$start[counts$chr == chr_name][1]
    if (is.na(start_chr)) next

    dt <- fread(f, header = TRUE, select = c("pos", "ihs"))
    dt <- dt[ihs > 0.5]

    if (nrow(dt) == 0) {
      rm(dt)
      gc()
      next
    }

    dt[, chr := factor(chr_name, levels = chr_levels)]
    dt[, x := start_chr + seq_len(.N) - 1L]

    df_list[[chr_name]] <- dt
    rm(dt)
    gc()
  }

  df <- rbindlist(df_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = ihs, color = chr)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = counts$center[counts$n_snps > 0],
      labels = gsub("^chr", "", as.character(counts$chr[counts$n_snps > 0])),
      expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = rep(c("#2C3E50", "#95A5A6"), length.out = length(chr_levels))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      text = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", size = 22),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "\nChromosome",
      y = "iHS\n",
      title = pop_name
    )
}

for (pop_name in pops) {
  message("Processing: ", pop_name)

  p <- make_pop_plot(pop_name)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(figures_path, "selection", paste0("ihs_", pop_name, ".png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 18,
    height = 3,
    dpi = 300
  )

  rm(p)
  gc()
}

```


```{r}
xpehh_path   <- file.path(reports_path, "selection", "xpehh")

pair_dirs <- list.dirs(xpehh_path, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

first_or_na <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else x[1]
}

read_one_out <- function(out_file, chr_name, pair_name) {
  dt <- fread(out_file)
  nms <- names(dt)

  pos_col <- first_or_na(nms[grepl("pos|bp|base", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)])
  if (is.na(pos_col)) pos_col <- nms[2]

  score_col <- first_or_na(nms[nms == "norm_xpehh"])
  if (is.na(score_col)) score_col <- first_or_na(nms[grepl("xpehh|xp_ehh|score|stat|value|val", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)])
  if (is.na(score_col)) score_col <- nms[length(nms)]

  dt <- dt[, .(
    pair = pair_name,
    chr  = chr_name,
    pos  = as.numeric(get(pos_col)),
    stat = as.numeric(get(score_col))
  )]

  dt[!is.na(pos) & !is.na(stat)]
}

save_pair_plot <- function(pair_dir, plot_dir, tail_prob = 0.001) {
  pair_name     <- basename(pair_dir)
  chr_levels_xp <- c(paste0("chr", 1:14), "chrZ")
  chr_dirs      <- list.dirs(pair_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

  # Detect relevant column names from the file header only (zero data read)
  detect_cols <- function(out_file) {
    nms       <- names(fread(out_file, nrows = 0))
    pos_col   <- first_or_na(nms[grepl("pos|bp|base", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)])
    if (is.na(pos_col)) pos_col <- nms[2]
    score_col <- first_or_na(nms[nms == "norm_xpehh"])
    if (is.na(score_col)) score_col <- first_or_na(nms[grepl("xpehh|xp_ehh|score|stat|value|val", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)])
    if (is.na(score_col)) score_col <- nms[length(nms)]
    list(pos = pos_col, stat = score_col)
  }

  # Build file manifest (header reads only)
  file_info <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(chr_dirs, function(chr_dir) {
    out_file <- list.files(chr_dir, pattern = "\\.xpehh\\.out\\.norm$", full.names = TRUE)
    if (!length(out_file)) return(NULL)
    list(file = out_file[1], chr = basename(chr_dir), cols = detect_cols(out_file[1]))
  }))

  if (length(file_info) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  # Pass 1: read only the stat column per chromosome → global quantile thresholds
  # Each chromosome's vector is freed before the next is read.
  stat_vals <- numeric(0)
  for (fi in file_info) {
    dt        <- fread(fi$file, select = fi$cols$stat)
    v         <- as.numeric(dt[[1]])
    rm(dt); gc()
    stat_vals <- c(stat_vals, v[!is.na(v)])
  }

  if (length(stat_vals) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  lower <- quantile(stat_vals, probs = tail_prob,       na.rm = TRUE, type = 8)
  upper <- quantile(stat_vals, probs = 1 - tail_prob,   na.rm = TRUE, type = 8)
  rm(stat_vals); gc()

  # Pass 2: read only pos + stat per chromosome, record chr length, keep outliers only
  chr_len_list <- vector("list", length(file_info))
  outlier_list <- vector("list", length(file_info))

  for (i in seq_along(file_info)) {
    fi <- file_info[[i]]
    dt <- fread(fi$file, select = c(fi$cols$pos, fi$cols$stat))
    setnames(dt, c("pos", "stat"))
    dt[, pos  := as.numeric(pos)]
    dt[, stat := as.numeric(stat)]
    dt <- dt[!is.na(pos) & !is.na(stat)]

    chr_len_list[[i]] <- data.table(chr = fi$chr, chr_len = max(dt$pos, na.rm = TRUE))

    dt <- dt[stat <= lower | stat >= upper]
    if (nrow(dt) > 0) {
      dt[, chr := fi$chr]
      outlier_list[[i]] <- dt
    }
    rm(dt); gc()
  }

  chr_info <- rbindlist(chr_len_list)
  rm(chr_len_list); gc()

  chr_info[, chr := factor(chr, levels = chr_levels_xp)]
  setorder(chr_info, chr)
  chr_info[, offset := shift(cumsum(chr_len), fill = 0)]
  chr_info[, center := offset + chr_len / 2]

  outliers <- rbindlist(Filter(Negate(is.null), outlier_list), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  rm(outlier_list); gc()

  if (nrow(outliers) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  outliers[, chr := factor(chr, levels = chr_levels_xp)]
  outliers[chr_info, offset := i.offset, on = "chr"]
  outliers[, x_plot := pos + offset]

  p <- ggplot(outliers, aes(x = x_plot, y = stat, col = chr)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.35, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = upper, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = lower, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(
        rep(c("#2C3E50", "#95A5A6"), length.out = length(chr_levels_xp)),
        chr_levels_xp
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = chr_info$center,
      labels = gsub("chr|scaffold", "", chr_info$chr),
      expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(pair_name, " (", 100 * tail_prob, "% tails)"),
      x = "\nChromosome",
      y = "XPEHH\n"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      text = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", size = 22),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(pair_name, "_xpehh_outliers.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 3,
    dpi = 300
  )

  rm(outliers, chr_info, p)
  gc()
  invisible(NULL)
}

plot_dir <- file.path(figures_path, "xpehh")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (pair_dir in pair_dirs) {
  save_pair_plot(pair_dir, plot_dir, tail_prob = 0.001)
}

```

```{r}
all_data <- rbindlist(lapply(pair_dirs, function(pair_dir) {
  pair_name <- basename(pair_dir)
  chr_dirs <- list.dirs(pair_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

  rbindlist(lapply(chr_dirs, function(chr_dir) {
    out_file <- list.files(chr_dir, pattern = "\\.xpehh\\.out\\.norm$", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(out_file) == 0) return(NULL)

    chr_name <- basename(chr_dir)
    read_one_out(out_file[1], chr_name, pair_name)
  }), fill = TRUE)
}), fill = TRUE)

all_data[, c("pop1", "pop2") := tstrsplit(pair, "_vs_")]

all_data[, stat_std := as.numeric(scale(stat)), by = pair]

# all_data already created with:
# pair, chr, pos, stat
# and:
# all_data[, c("pop1", "pop2") := tstrsplit(pair, "_vs_")]
# all_data[, stat_std := as.numeric(scale(stat)), by = pair]

window_size <- 1e5   # 100 kb
threshold   <- 2     # after orientation, use positive threshold
min_pairs   <- 2     # region must appear in at least this many pairwise comparisons

find_common_regions_for_pop <- function(all_data, target_pop,
                                        window_size = 1e5,
                                        threshold = 2,
                                        min_pairs = 2) {
  dt <- all_data[pop1 == target_pop | pop2 == target_pop]
  if (nrow(dt) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Orient so positive always means selection in target_pop
  dt[, sel_stat := fifelse(pop1 == target_pop, stat_std, -stat_std)]

  # Bin into windows
  dt[, window := floor(pos / window_size)]

  # Summarize by pair/chromosome/window
  window_stats <- dt[, .(
    mean_sel = mean(sel_stat, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_sel  = max(sel_stat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_sel  = min(sel_stat, na.rm = TRUE)
  ), by = .(pair, chr, window)]

  # Keep windows with strong positive signal in target population
  selected_windows <- window_stats[max_sel >= threshold]

  if (nrow(selected_windows) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Count how many comparisons support each region
  common_regions <- selected_windows[, .N, by = .(chr, window)]
  common_regions <- common_regions[N >= min_pairs]

  if (nrow(common_regions) == 0) return(NULL)

  common_regions[, `:=`(
    pop = target_pop,
    start = window * window_size,
    end   = (window + 1) * window_size
  )]

  # Add supporting pair count and mean signal
  support <- selected_windows[, .(
    n_pairs = uniqueN(pair),
    strongest = max(max_sel, na.rm = TRUE)
  ), by = .(chr, window)]

  common_regions <- merge(common_regions, support, by = c("chr", "window"), all.x = TRUE)
  common_regions[order(chr, start)]
}

# Run for all populations
pops <- sort(unique(c(all_data$pop1, all_data$pop2)))

regions_by_pop <- lapply(pops, function(p) {
  find_common_regions_for_pop(
    all_data = all_data,
    target_pop = p,
    window_size = window_size,
    threshold = threshold,
    min_pairs = min_pairs
  )
})

names(regions_by_pop) <- pops

# Combine into one table
common_regions_all <- rbindlist(regions_by_pop, fill = TRUE)

common_regions_all


# keep only supported windows
hits <- common_regions_all[n_pairs >= 2][order(pop, chr, start)]

# merge adjacent 100 kb windows into continuous regions
hits[, gap := start - shift(end, fill = first(start)), by = .(pop, chr)]
hits[, region_id := cumsum(is.na(gap) | gap > 0), by = .(pop, chr)]

regions <- hits[, .(
  region_start = min(start),
  region_end   = max(end),
  n_windows    = .N,
  n_pairs_max  = max(n_pairs, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_pairs_mean = mean(n_pairs, na.rm = TRUE),
  strongest    = max(strongest, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(pop, chr, region_id)]

regions[, region_size_kb := (region_end - region_start) / 1000]
regions <- regions[order(pop, chr, region_start)]
regions

top_regions <- regions[order(pop, -n_pairs_max, -strongest, -region_size_kb)]
top_regions

summary_by_pop <- regions[, .(
  n_regions = .N,
  total_kb  = sum(region_size_kb, na.rm = TRUE),
  best_chr  = chr[which.max(strongest)],
  best_start = region_start[which.max(strongest)],
  best_end   = region_end[which.max(strongest)],
  best_strongest = max(strongest, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = pop]

summary_by_pop

top5_by_pop <- regions[, head(.SD[order(-n_pairs_max, -strongest)], 5), by = pop]
top5_by_pop

filtered_regions <- regions[
  n_pairs_max >= 3 &          # consistent across all comparisons
  strongest >= 5 &            # strong signal
  region_size_kb <= 5000      # <= 5 Mb (important!)
]

filtered_regions[order(pop, -strongest)]

merge_gap <- 1e6  # 1 Mb gap allowed

setorder(filtered_regions, pop, chr, region_start)

filtered_regions[, gap := region_start - shift(region_end), by = .(pop, chr)]
filtered_regions[, group := cumsum(is.na(gap) | gap > merge_gap), by = .(pop, chr)]

merged_regions <- filtered_regions[, .(
  region_start = min(region_start),
  region_end   = max(region_end),
  strongest    = max(strongest),
  n_regions    = .N
), by = .(pop, chr, group)]

merged_regions[, size_kb := (region_end - region_start)/1000]
merged_regions[order(pop, chr, region_start)]
```
